title: Completion publishes transaction and balance events only after the metadata and fee-debt projections, so a projection failure loses them

bugs.note: The SQL write has committed when the projections run. If the Mongo metadata or the fee-debt record fails, the record goes back for a retry whose SQL replay reports the noop phase, and a noop publishes nothing. The transaction.*, balance.changed and overdraft events for money that did move are never sent, so consumers that keep balances or notify customers miss it.
